user_decision: Use DF40 as sole release source for this extension, including its linked real-data package.
scope: Inference-only evaluation of existing GenImage-trained detectors; no DF40 training or fitted calibration.

methods.reason: Identity replacement with a single-frame face-swapping method.
Image-driven facial motion/animation; contrasts identity replacement.
Audio-driven mouth modification; localized facial alteration. Evaluate still-image artifacts only, not audiovisual synchronization.

selection_limit: Three operationally different manipulations spanning two of four DF40 categories. This smoke does not represent all 40 methods.

split_policy.smoke: Separate operational test set, excluded from final reported test metrics.
split_policy.test: Frozen official CDF test-pool subset, with all known source/identity links to smoke excluded.
split_policy.warning: In all three audited CDF JSON files, val and test contain identical normalized image paths. Do not use these aliases as independent splits.
split_policy.tuning: Any checkpoint, threshold, prompt, preprocessing or ensemble selection based on DF40 labels requires a separate development/validation pool and untouched test groups.
split_policy.future_training: If adaptation is later requested, create group-disjoint train/validation/test sets as a new experiment, respecting official split roles.

sample.selection: FNV1a32 rank of 566:method:video_group; six distinct known primary identity IDs per class/method; median numeric available frame.
sample.reuse: Same six real images in each of the three method comparisons. Do not count them as eighteen independent real samples.
sample.frame_policy: Use released face crops without additional face recropping or re-encoding. Retain supplied image bytes and compute SHA256. Model-specific deterministic resize/crop and normalization remain as in training.
sample.membership_status: Pending source-group mapping and archive-member verification; no fabricated image hashes or claimed extracted files.
quality_review: Trace official metadata and archive member
Check face crop, relevant region, readability and wrong-face risk
Compare reliably corresponding originals where available; record mapping uncertainty
Retain subtle fakes; do not filter by detector score or obviousness
Log confirmed failures and unresolved frame-edit status before inference

vit.backbone: Existing OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 weights, frozen.
vit.feature_policy: L2-normalized float image features; saved linear head; sigmoid; fake=1 and threshold0.5.
vit.runtime: eval(), requires_grad=False and inference_mode(); no training runner, optimizer, adaptation or automatic model download.

acceptance: Verify head SHA256 and source protocol against saved completion markers.
Replay a small original GenImage clean reference and compare probabilities before domain transfer.
Verify decoded images, labels, SHA256 identities and exactly24 rows per head.
Finite scores in[0,1], reproducible repeated inference, unchanged checkpoint/backbone hashes.
Record per-method metrics and raw scores descriptively; no accuracy threshold for smoke acceptance.
Create explicit PASS only after these checks execute; retain failures and resolve before larger evaluation.

after_pass.team_release: Create versioned shared media subset plus manifest, policy, source citations, archive/member provenance, exact hashes and source-group exclusions.
after_pass.initial_test_proposal: 100 shared real images +100 fake images per method=400 unique images; one frame per video group where available. Each method has a balanced200-image comparison; final count subject to grouping audit.
after_pass.evaluation: AUROC, accuracy@0.5, fake recall, real FPR, F1 and confusion counts per manipulation; equal-weight method summary. Shared real images induce dependence.
after_pass.model_coordination: Same image bytes and test membership for ViT, CNN and multimodal; CNN head choices and multimodal prompt/model/budget recorded before test.
after_pass.expansion: Add methods in versioned releases chosen by category coverage and data availability, preserving prior test IDs and avoiding selection by favorable detection scores.

media_policy: No full dataset archive download in this milestone; first verify bounded archive-member access. Stop if a small subset cannot be retrieved without a substantial download.
